family_reports.body: It has destroyed my mental Health. I have PTSD and CPTSD from domestic abuse as well as litigation, financial, and medical abuse. My records were published publicly as were my children’s by the Court allowing others to misuse my records and data for further financial harm and legal proceedings. It has cost me my financial stability, income and ability to care for my medical needs and safety of me and my children and taken from my business.

They have bypassed every guideline put into place to prevent third party take over. What they did was a**backwards. Amy Eddy. Failed our children. And she preaches she loves our constitution. Really?? Certainly not the part about parents and their children. And Marybeth Sampsel Advocate for families?! That is a really cute way of saying predator.
